stage: P3.1 arXiv read-only tools, first step only
purpose: Search paper metadata and read a pinned primary PDF with page, URL, hash, and retrieval provenance.
limits: No automatic Agent integration, no permanent KB import, no LLM API calls or claim that networking improves answers.
assumption: User explicitly selected arXiv papers for P3 via the source-scope question.
acceptance: Bounded deterministic offline HTTP/PDF tests, then minimal live metadata/PDF smoke if available; preserve failures.
